xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1.The Board of Directors has declared second interim dividend of Rs. 14.40 per equity share of Rs. 10/- each.

The Company had declared and paid a first interim dividend of Rs. 14.40 per equity share of Rs. 10/- each during the year.

The total interim dividends for the year declared aggregates to Rs. 28.80 per equity share.

2.Following were the changes to the fleet during and subsequent to the quarter:

Sales
-delivered its 2009 built Long Range 2 Tanker Jag Lokesh which was contracted for sale in earlier quarter.

Purchases
-took delivery of Long Range 2 Tanker built in 2015 renamed as Jag Laxman.
-contracted to buy a secondhand Kamsarmax Dry Bulk Carrier built in 2015 renamed as Jag Amit and took delivery subsequent to the end of the quarter.
-contracted to buy a secondhand Kamsarmax Dry Bulk Carrier built in 2019 for delivery in the third quarter of Financial Year 2026-27.
-contracted for acquisition of a new building Suezmax Tanker for delivery in second half of FY 2028-29.
-contracted to buy a secondhand Very Large Gas Carrier built in 2015 for delivery in the third quarter of Financial Year 2026-27.

3.During the quarter, the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on August 27, 2026 has approved a proposal for the Company to buy back its own fully paid-up equity shares of a face value of Rs. 10/- each, for an amount not exceeding Rs. 900 (excl. transaction costs) crores for a price not exceeding Rs. 1530/- per equity share from the shareholders of the Company (other than the Promoters and shareholders belonging to Promoters Group of the Company) payable in cash, through open market route through the stock exchange mechanism, in accordance with the provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018 (as amended) and the Companies Act, 2013 (including the rules and regulations framed thereunder).

The Company bought back 1,858,941 equity shares of Rs. 10 each during the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The total amount utilized for the buyback up to September 30, 2026 was Rs. 262.72 crores (excl. transaction costs). Further, subsequent to the end of the quarter, the Company bought back an additional 2,418,253 equity shares. The total amount utilized for the buyback after the quarter end and up to the date of this report was 364.70 crores (excl. transaction costs).

Accordingly, the total buyback of the equity shares till the date of board meeting aggregates to 4,277,194 equity shares utilising an amount of Rs. 627.42 crores (excl. transaction costs).

Out of the above 3,848,494 equity shares bought back have been extinguished subsequent to end of quarter till the date of the Board meeting. Consequently, the subscribed and paid up equity share capital, as reduced by Rs. 3.85 crores, is Rs. 138.92 crores as on the date of Board meeting

4. The above financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on November 06, 2026. The statutory auditors of the Company have carried out a Limited Review of the results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
5. The results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, are available on BSE Ltd. website (URL:www.bseindia.com/corporates), on National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. website (URL:www.nseindia.com/corporates) and on the Company website (URL:www.greatship.com/ financial_result.html).

6. Additional disclosures as per Clause 52(4) and Clause 54(2) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 :

(a) As per the terms of issue of 4500 Secured Redeemable Non-convertible Debentures of Rs. 10 lakhs each, the Company has created and maintained exclusive charge on ships (over 1.20 times cover on market value of ships) and additional security by way of mortgage on immovable property.

As per the terms of issue of 3500 Unsecured Redeemable Non-convertible Debentures of Rs. 10 lakhs each, the Company has maintained unencumbered assets (including cash and cash equivalents) of market value not less than outstanding face value amount of these debentures.
